sermon.title: What is a Christian? August 25, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer), likely Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Disciples were first called Christians in Antioch because they assembled, taught the word, helped one another, fasted and ministered to the Lord. Church is not a customer business; we come to meet with God, serve one another in unity, and add to our faith, since even demons believe.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Worship comes first; the message starts ~24:32. He said “Psalms 19” for “your word is a lamp to my feet” (Psalm 119:105); left as said, cited correctly.
